summary: The final done-true value of the delegated iterator becomes the value of the yield* expression.

tests.name: inner return becomes yield-star value
tests.input: function* inner(){return 4} function* outer(){return yield* inner()} console.log(outer().next());

tests.name: outer can transform completion value
tests.input: function* inner(){yield 1;return 4} function* outer(){const x=yield* inner();return x+1} const it=outer();it.next();console.log(it.next());
